description: This file defines a class ListView within the Step\Acceptance namespace, extending AcceptanceTester, providing methods to interact with list view elements in a web application under test, such as clicking on record names, filtering, and waiting for UI elements.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class providing actions to interact with list view UI components in acceptance tests.

methods.name: clickNameLink
methods.description: Clicks on a record's name link within the list view.

methods.name: clickFilterButton
methods.description: Clicks the filter button to open the filter modal.

methods.name: clearFilterButton
methods.description: Clears any applied filters in the list view.

methods.name: waitForListViewVisible
methods.description: Waits until the list view is visible.

methods.name: waitForFilterModalVisible
methods.description: Waits until the filter modal dialog is visible.

methods.name: waitForFilterModalNotVisible
methods.description: Waits until the filter modal dialog is no longer visible.
